articles.body:
I had a question on some of the India events after my 3--handed learning play through.

I had 4 India events to resolve. I revealed and resolved a Crisis.  Then the elephant marched to a company-controlled region so I placed the elephant in that region as instructed.  The next event was a Leader event for a dominated region.  I resolved the rebellion, which was successful, and then followed the Elephants March procedure again, which moved the elephant out of the previous conpany-controlled region.  Should I have done that?  I was using the player aid which just says to "resolve a Rebellion", which in turn the rule book (under Crisis) says you always resolve an elephants march afterwards.  But the rules about the Leader event say something about a company controlled region successfully rebelling and wasn't sure if I played this correctly?

In other words....  does the Elephant ONLY march from a Leader rebellion IF the Leader rebellion is in a company-controlled region AND that rebellion was successful?
articles.bodyXml:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<xml><safehtml>I had a question on some of the India events after my 3--handed learning play through.<br/><br/>I had 4 India events to resolve. I revealed and resolved a Crisis.  Then the elephant marched to a company-controlled region so I placed the elephant in that region as instructed.  The next event was a Leader event for a dominated region.  I resolved the rebellion, which was successful, and then followed the Elephants March procedure again, which moved the elephant out of the previous conpany-controlled region.  Should I have done that?  I was using the player aid which just says to "resolve a Rebellion", which in turn the rule book (under Crisis) says you always resolve an elephants march afterwards.  But the rules about the Leader event say something about a company controlled region successfully rebelling and wasn't sure if I played this correctly?<br/><br/>In other words....  does the Elephant ONLY march from a Leader rebellion IF the Leader rebellion is in a company-controlled region AND that rebellion was successful?</safehtml></xml>

articles.body:
Your conclusion is correct, the elephant only marches in a Leader event if it was resolved in a company-controlled region and that rebellion was successful as per the rules under pg. 31:

"Elephant Redirect. If the Elephant was fully within a Companycontrolled region that successfully rebelled, perform an
Elephant's March. (Otherwise this event does not move the Elephant.)"

articles.body:
[q="Bridger"]I recommend printing out this [filepage=245812]excellent 1-page elephant player aid[/filepage] made by @jmoslainte.  It is very clear and easy to follow.[/q]

In this specific case, the chart seems to contradict the rules because the chart instructs you to perform a march in case of a successful rebellion whereas you will only perform it if it is a successful rebellion against a company-controlled region (and not of a dominated region against the capital).

It is really strange that the rules in the "Crisis" section on page 32 contradict those in the "Leader"/"Elephant Redirect" section on page 31 regarding elephant march following a successful rebellion of a dominated region against its capital (Page 32 instructs you to perform a march, page 31 says there is no march).

No, it is not.  Leader Events and Crisis events are two different things.  The chart only shows you how to resolve a Crisis event.  The Leader event details that the resolution procedure the same as a Crisis Rebellion under X circumstance, with exception Y.
